payload.use_case_title: Real-time fraud scoring on the card-authorisation stream
payload.use_case_summary: Scores card authorisations inline and needs sub-100ms lookups of a rolling per-account feature set. Today the stream lands in Confluent, features are precomputed nightly in Snowflake, and the scoring service reads a self-managed Postgres that they operate on EC2.
payload.goal: Work out whether Lakebase can replace the self-managed Postgres feature store without adding a hop.
blockers: Nightly feature refresh means fraud models score on stale features during the day.
Two engineers spend roughly a day a week patching and failing over the EC2 Postgres.
Snowflake egress costs make the per-account lookup pattern uneconomic at their volume.
interest_signals: Asked directly what Lakebase costs at 40k lookups/second.
Wants to know whether synced tables can keep the feature set current from the streaming pipeline.
Said their platform team has budget approved for a feature-store replacement this year.
payload.timeline: wants a decision before their Snowflake renewal in Q3
